platform.account_deletion_days: Days before a deleted account is erased
platform.demo_enabled: Demo open to visitors, through Try the demo
platform.demo_sandboxes_max: Most demos at the same time
platform.import_max_rows: Most rows in one imported file
platform.company_reopen_days: Days a closed company can be reopened
platform.licensing_grace_days: Days of grace after a subscription ends
platform.licensing_hold_days: Days of access while a payment is confirmed

settings.intro: The company's defaults. A customer, a product or a document may still say otherwise.
settings.forbidden: Changing the company's settings needs the settings permission.

document.how_to_pay: Print how to pay on invoices (IBAN, BIC, number to quote)
document.amount_in_words: Write the total out in words on documents
document.savings_line: Print under the totals what the discounts save (“You save …”)
document.paid_stamp: Stamp what became of the invoice on its up-to-date copy (« Paid », « Settled », « Partly paid »)
document.names_as_issued: Print copies with the unit and tax names of the day they were issued (otherwise, today’s)
document.late_payment_rate_hint: Printed where the law asks for it, for example « three times the legal interest rate ».
document.exemption_reference_hint: Printed for an exempt customer, for example « article 261-4-4° du CGI ».
document.watermark_spread_hint: No effect while it prints once.

credit.limit_hint: 0: none. Beyond it, a notification says so after the invoice that passes it.

article.show_price_excl_tax: Also show the price without tax to what faces a customer
article.reference_format_hint: Letters, digits and . _ / - around exactly one {SEQ} or {SEQ:n} (n digits): ART-{SEQ:5} gives ART-00042. A category may have its own; the number comes from one counter for the company.
article.price_on_cost_change_hint: When a receipt changes a product’s cost price under its selling price: offer to adjust the price (the margin shows until someone decides), keep the price, or keep the margin.

stock.cost_on_receive: What a stock receipt does to a product's cost

customer_screen.show_stock: Say on the customer screen whether a product is in stock or not

watch.lot_expiry_days: Watch: a lot is flagged this many days before its expiry date
watch.lead_days: Watch: restocking lead time (days) under which stock running out is flagged
watch.late_after_days_hint: In “To watch”, a customer is flagged when an invoice is this many days late.
watch.unsold_after_days_hint: In “To watch”, a product is flagged when it has not sold for this many days.

aged_balance.first_days: Aged balance: end of the 1st bracket (days)
aged_balance.second_days: Aged balance: end of the 2nd bracket (days)
aged_balance.third_days: Aged balance: end of the 3rd bracket (days)

delivery_note.reception_block: Print the receipt block (date and time, name, signature and stamp, reservations)

invoice.receiver_hint: On an invoice handing the goods over itself, with no delivery note.

presentation.scan_feedback: Beep and buzz on each scan
presentation.scan_recount_ms: Camera scan: delay before a code counts again (ms)

cost_on_receive.suggest: Offer the choice at each receipt
cost_on_receive.last: Apply the cost of the last receipt

overrides.title: Values set for the company
overrides.intro: Resetting a value returns it to the default.
overrides.reset_done: {{label}} takes the value from the level above again.

errors.invalid: Nothing was saved: correct the fields marked.
errors.network: The server could not be reached.

coming.title: Coming
coming.intro: The settings of the modules to come, in words: nothing is there to choose yet.

quote.signature_block: Print the “Agreed” block (date, name, signature) on quotes
quote.receiver: Name who accepted or refused a quote

activity.retention_months: How long the activity journal is kept (months, 12 to 36)

reminders.enabled_hint: When an invoice reaches a stage of the calendar, the people who issue invoices are told it is time to remind the customer. Nothing is sent to the customer.
reminders.stages_hint: Up to five numbers separated by commas, for example 7, 15, 30.
reminders.hour_hint: From this hour each day, the stages reached are recorded.

late_fees.enabled_hint: When an invoice reaches a reminder stage, a late fee is prepared as a draft invoice for the customer. Nothing is issued without you.
late_fees.tiers_hint: An amount or a percentage of what is still owed for each stage, separated by semicolons, for example 5; 10; 2%. A stage left empty costs nothing. No amount is proposed by default.

purchase_receipt.receiver_hint: At each receipt of an order to a vendor, a member of the company or a name typed.
